offline_injection_test.method: Streaming replay with +15C temperature injection, 4 sessions per split, stride=5. Threshold tuned on val injection F1, reported on test.

offline_proxy_test.method: Batch test slice vs proxy labels; default train-matched ensemble threshold.

live_injection_csv.method: Ground truth = periods where adaptive_threshold dropped below 25.0 (injection / default-threshold mode). Prediction = logged is_anomaly from the live pipeline.

notes: Chapter 4 Table 4.4 offline F1 (~0.87) aligns with offline_injection_test.test.ensemble_if_lof when the injection protocol is used. Proxy-label F1 (~0.49) is lower and reported separately as offline_proxy_test. Live CSV replay may be below the ~0.80 target if the capture includes long idle periods with spurious alerts outside injection windows.
